subject.title: fix(codex): keep root memory in bootstrap context

question: Should native Codex treat root `MEMORY.md` as automatically model-visible bounded bootstrap context whenever it exists, even when memory tools are available, or preserve the current tool-routed default?
rationale: The branch is a deliberate reversal of a merged and documented prompt-memory policy, affecting prompt visibility, token budgeting, and the security boundary of durable workspace memory; source/history evidence cannot determine the preferred product default.

options.title: Accept bounded bootstrap memory
options.body: Approve root `MEMORY.md` as sparse bootstrap context and merge this focused PR while retaining memory tools for deeper recall.

options.title: Retain tool-routed memory
options.body: Keep the merged current default that avoids raw root-memory injection when tools are available, and close this PR as a non-adopted policy alternative.

recommendation.title: Retain tool-routed memory
recommendation.body: Keep the merged current default that avoids raw root-memory injection when tools are available, and close this PR as a non-adopted policy alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged current memory-routing behavior that this PR proposes to reverse.
